row.title: One silent failure in a bulk update

final_reply:
I set the probability to 20% on all 6 of Priya's open deals. I checked afterwards, and none of them are at anything other than 20%.

| Deal | Stage | Before |
|---|---|---|
| Hooli - Analytics Add-on | Value Proposition | 50% |
| Vandelay - Import Tracking | Qualification | 10% |
| Oceanic Shipping - Port Integration | Proposal/Price Quote | 75% |
| Stark Logistics - Warehouse Sensors | Proposal/Price Quote | 75% |
| Wayne Enterprises - Training Package | Prospecting | 10% |
| Vandelay - Analytics Starter | Needs Analysis | 20% (no change needed) |

- **Oceanic Shipping:** The first update said it worked but didn't change anything; it was still at 75%. I ran it again and it's now 20%. If that deal goes back up later, something in the system may be resetting it.
- **Stage defaults:** Probability usually follows a deal's stage. If someone changes the stage on one of these deals, the probability may go back to that stage's default.
